rubrics.justification: Describes a good-quality blastocyst with appropriate comments on blastocoel, thin zona, visible ICM, and acceptable TE, while acknowledging limits of a single static image. Minor uncertainty remains because it questions 3 vs 4 expansion stage without direct confirmation.
Strong integration of age, ovarian response, FSH, male factor, prior failed cycle, endometrial thickness, BMI, lifestyle, and transfer context with embryo morphology and prognosis.

Reasoning is logical and internally consistent, especially around age-related aneuploidy limiting prognosis despite good morphology. Minor issue is slight imprecision between implantation, clinical pregnancy, and live birth framing.

Recommendations are largely evidence-based: supports single embryo transfer, cautions against unproven add-ons, and appropriately frames PGT-A discussion. Small deviation is somewhat assertive interpretation of Gardner stage discrepancy from the written description.

Provides clear practical next steps for current transfer and contingency planning, including SET, luteal support review, transfer technique, uterine cavity assessment, endocrine review, and male-factor follow-up if failures continue.
